because / because of / so · 要点精讲: Causal connectives: because gives the reason, so gives the result; never use both in the same sentence.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:because introduces a clause, because of + noun; so introduces a result; the two cannot be used together in one sentence。
because + clause (subject + verb)|because of + noun/noun phrase|so introduces a result clause|Because S1, S2 = S1, so S2|since/as can also express a reason, with a weaker tone than because
I stayed at home because it rained.
column3: 因为下雨,我待在了家里。

# title: I stayed at home _____ it rained.
column4: 考查because introduces a clause, because of + noun; so introduces a result; the two cannot be used together in one sentence。此处应为 because。句意:因为下雨,我待在了家里。
